# has reference position

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasReferencePosition`](gmeow-hasReferencePosition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasReferencePosition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The origin position of a celestial reference frame (topocentric, geocentric, barycentric, heliocentric). Functional: a frame has exactly one reference position.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:CelestialReferenceOrigin`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialReferenceOrigin.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasReferencePosition`](gmeow-hasReferencePosition.md) from [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) to [`gmeow:CelestialReferenceOrigin`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialReferenceOrigin.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md), [`gmeow:CelestialReferenceOrigin`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialReferenceOrigin.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the origin of a celestial reference frame (topocentric, geocentric, barycentric, heliocentric); functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for terrestrial frame origins and avoid more than one position per frame.

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:CelestialReferenceOrigin`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialReferenceOrigin.md) individual (aligned to IVOA refposition).

### Examples

- ex:icrsFrame [`gmeow:hasReferencePosition`](gmeow-hasReferencePosition.md) [`gmeow:refOriginBarycentric`](../individuals/gmeow-refOriginBarycentric.md).
